note: NON-SECRET, NON-EXECUTING plan. It describes the exact future sequence for seeding eight INACTIVE rows into the EXISTING public.communication_provider_template_mappings table in STAGING ONLY. It contains no SQL statement, no credential, no project URL, no database identifier and no remote provider identifier. Running it requires a separate, explicit owner authorization in a later phase (QF-MVP-40.12). Nothing in this file authorizes a database connection, a provider call, a mapping activation or a send.

collision_basis.active_uniqueness: uq_comm_provider_template_active — PARTIAL unique index WHERE is_active
collision_basis.note: Both constraints already exist in migration 20260709000100. The row-level unique index makes a deterministic conflict target available, and the partial active index makes two competing active mappings structurally impossible. No new schema, index or migration is required, and none may be added by the seed.

invariants: Staging only. The effective project must be proven staging BEFORE any read.
Every seeded row is written with is_active false.
An existing ACTIVE mapping is never replaced, flipped, deactivated or overwritten — the seed aborts instead.
The provider account stays DISABLED for the entire operation.
Runtime policy stays disabled for the entire operation.
No provider template id is required: the Meta send payload is keyed on template name + language, so the column may remain null.
Zero message sends and zero provider write calls.
Any uncertainty rolls the transaction back rather than committing a partial seed.
Sanitized evidence is archived OUTSIDE the repository; no evidence file enters Git.

steps.name: PROVE_STAGING_IDENTITY
steps.detail: Resolve the effective environment through the project's own env loader and prove the target project is the staging project. Abort if the effective project is production or cannot be proven. A production service key present in a local env file is a known hazard, so identity must be proven, not assumed.

steps.name: VERIFY_SCHEMA_READINESS
steps.detail: Confirm public.communication_provider_template_mappings exists with template_key, channel, provider_key, language, version, provider_template_name, provider_template_id, approval_status and is_active, and that uq_comm_provider_template_mapping and uq_comm_provider_template_active are both present. Abort if any is missing; never create schema during a seed.

steps.name: VERIFY_PROVIDER_ACCOUNT
steps.detail: Confirm the intended row exists in public.communication_provider_accounts and is DISABLED. If it does not exist, it is created DISABLED in a separately authorized phase — never inside this seed.

steps.name: READ_REMOTE_TEMPLATE_STATE
steps.detail: Read-only reconciliation against Meta by exact template name and language for each of the eight templates. No create, edit, delete or send. Abort on any status other than APPROVED or any returned category other than UTILITY.

steps.name: RESOLVE_REMOTE_IDS_IN_MEMORY
steps.detail: If a remote identifier is returned, hold it in memory only for the duration of the run. It is never written to Git, never logged, and is not required for dispatch.

steps.name: CHECK_COLLISIONS
steps.detail: For each template, query the existing rows on the uq_comm_provider_template_mapping tuple. Abort if a conflicting row exists that is active, or that differs in provider_template_name, language or category.

steps.name: BEGIN_TRANSACTION
steps.detail: Open a single transaction covering all eight writes. A partial seed is never acceptable.

steps.name: WRITE_INACTIVE_MAPPINGS
steps.detail: Insert or upsert exactly eight rows on the uq_comm_provider_template_mapping conflict target, each with is_active false and approval_status approved. Provider template id may remain null.

steps.name: REFUSE_ACTIVE_REPLACEMENT
steps.detail: If any conflict target resolves to a row where is_active is true, the seed never proceeds with that row: it aborts the whole transaction. An active mapping is only ever changed by an explicit, separately authorized activation phase.

steps.name: READ_BACK_ROWS
steps.detail: Re-read the eight rows by their exact tuple and compare template_key, channel, provider_key, language, version, provider_template_name and approval_status against the readiness artefact.

steps.name: PROVE_ALL_INACTIVE
steps.detail: Assert every seeded row has is_active false, and that the count of active mappings for the affected tuples is zero.

steps.name: PROVE_ACCOUNT_STILL_DISABLED
steps.detail: Re-read the provider account and assert it is still disabled and unchanged by the seed.

steps.name: PROVE_RUNTIME_POLICY_DISABLED
steps.detail: Assert the communication runtime policy remains disabled so no send path can open as a side effect of seeding.

steps.name: COMMIT_ONLY_IF_ALL_PASS
steps.detail: Commit only when every preceding check passed. Any failed check leaves the transaction uncommitted.

steps.name: ROLLBACK_ON_UNCERTAINTY
steps.detail: On any error, ambiguous result, timeout or unknown outcome, roll back. An uncertain write is treated as a failed write and is never retried blindly.

steps.name: ARCHIVE_SANITIZED_EVIDENCE
steps.detail: Write a sanitized run record to the external operator evidence archive: counts, outcomes and template keys only. Never a remote id, account id, credential or raw provider response, and never inside the repository.

steps.name: ZERO_SENDS
steps.detail: Assert the run performed zero message sends and zero provider write calls, and record that assertion in the evidence.

abort_conditions: The effective environment cannot be proven to be staging.
Any required table, column or unique index is missing.
The provider account is missing, or is enabled rather than disabled.
Any template is not APPROVED, or its returned category is not UTILITY.
A conflicting mapping row exists that is active or semantically different.
Any read-back row differs from the readiness artefact.
Any seeded row is active after the write.
Runtime policy is enabled at any point during the run.
Any provider send or write call is observed.
explicit_non_authorizations: This plan does not authorize connecting to any database.
It does not authorize reading or writing Supabase in any environment.
It does not authorize a Meta API call.
It does not authorize creating or activating a provider account.
It does not authorize activating any mapping.
It does not authorize sending any WhatsApp message.
It does not authorize a migration, a staging canary or a deployment.
Execution requires a separate, explicit owner authorization naming the exact branch and commit SHA.

binding_governance.note: Step 8's variables_schema is no longer ambiguous. The five ordinary business templates now have a canonical typed source-key contract, and the seed operator requires BOTH the manifest and that code contract to agree before it will build a schema — a docs-only source_key is never accepted. The three consent acknowledgements remain zero-variable, for which an empty binding schema is authoritative. This resolves the BINDING_SCHEMA_UNPROVEN blocker only; it grants no mapping, activation or send authority, and the seed remains PLAN_ONLY_NOT_AUTHORIZED.
